items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: So I went to him and in a couple of lessons I had the horn down, you see, that was all the lesson.

ctx.x: Well I think Mituai was, as far as tone, you know. He played more on the style of a soloist, you know. He was a nice triple-tongued man and everything, you know.
Who taught you to play trumpet, Peter?

Well the old man Brookhoven, he had a band, he was an old German, you know. And the Brookhoven band, Brass Band, you know. He had a couple of boys play trumpet and one played in the theater, you know. Leo I think his name was, but his daddy, well you see I was a musician already because I was playing violin, but all I wanted to learn was the horn. See I knew the music and everything, see.
